title: IndiCASA: A Dataset and Bias Evaluation Framework in LLMs Using Contrastive Embedding Similarity in the Indian Context
findings: Religion exhibits relatively lower bias scores across most models compared to other bias types like caste, disability, or socioeconomic status. This suggests better neutrality, potentially due to religion being a globally sensitive axis that receives greater attention during model alignment or instruction tuning.
